milestone: M16: opt-in Vercel backend transport and signed anonymous session
scope: bounded follow-up chosen for user with limited remaining usage; no cloud publishing

checks.real_http_integration: proxy -> standalone backend -> Python: validate, RFECV train, single/batch predict, delete and expired handle

behavior.local: without remote configuration and outside Vercel, exact original handler is used
behavior.remote: all four private environment values required; partial configuration and unconfigured Vercel fail closed
behavior.routing: fixed allowlisted operation and method; no redirects or browser-supplied upstream URL/credentials
behavior.origin: exact configured origin and host; forwarded-host and cross-site requests rejected
behavior.sessions: origin-bound HMAC; 30-minute HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, Secure for HTTPS; infer/delete require existing valid cookie
behavior.errors: bounded JSON responses; service secret and upstream cookies/diagnostics are not reflected
behavior.timeouts: upstream fetch cancellation and bounded deadlines; API maxDuration 180 seconds

validation_scope.real_backend_fixture: 80-row synthetic numeric dataset, RFECV; not new energy research training
validation_scope.reason: no Python/backend implementation or UI changes; 127 existing website tests plus 7 proxy tests run
